newsitem.title: USA: Viacom sees Blockbuster revs improving in yr.
newsitem.headline: Viacom sees Blockbuster revs improving in yr.

text.p: Viacom Inc said on Friday it sees its Blockbuster unit generating improved EBITDA and revenues in the coming year.

"At Blockbuster, we continue to generate strong revenue growth as we expand both domestically and in key territories abroad," Chairman Sumner Redstone said in a statement of its third quarter results. "We are confident that we have the right management team and the right strategic blueprint to enhance EBITDA as well as revenue in the coming year."
Viacom's third quarter video revenues increased 18 percent to $726 million and EBITDA was up one percent to $194 million.
Viacom said its MTV Networks third quarter revenues of $349 million and EBITDA of $149 million each increased by 27 percent, mostly from double-digit gains in affiliate fees and advertising sales.

It said Paramount's third quarter gains reflect increased feature motion picture sales to television networks and a rise in cable and syndication revenues of the television programming library. The publishing unit posted a seven percent revenue increase in the quarter to $785 million from $735 million for a year ago on more sales from the higher education and international groups, it added.
